title: Reaching for Gold: Frequent-Flyer Status Incentives and Moral Hazard
authors: A. Yeşim Orhun; Tong Guo; Andreas Hagemann
eligible_reason: Frequent-flyer progress toward elite status and moral hazard: outcomes on progress-to-status bins (pp1-pp8, multi-valued) with fixed effects partialled out. Not a binary staggered adoption DiD.
design_notes: Package ships only replication_data.tgz with three residualized Stata files (data_residualized_P/RMS/fig5.dta, 8-24 GB each); header of data_residualized_P.dta: 45 vars, all 'Residuals' (r_rel_pricemedposrev, r_pp1_2yr..r_pp8_2yr, hub/nonhub and segment pp bins) plus account2. No code or README.
data_files_note: Only FE-residualized variables shipped; no identifiers for time, no code.
software_notes: No code shipped; data in Stata format.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Package contains data only (no code, no README). Out of scope.
